bf16: explicitly out of scope (Issue #11 disposition: plain shared BF16 UNSUPPORTED on this runtime)

substitution_rule: If an anchor is resource-infeasible, substitute the largest lower K from the frozen K grid at the same prefix, chosen only from the resource preflight before timing.
Do not duplicate an already-selected anchor at that prefix; step down again.
If no unique lower-K substitute exists, mark that anchor unavailable.
If fewer than 4 unique anchors remain feasible, the campaign may report measurements but may not issue a strong/conditional A2 performance verdict.

attribution.sequential_definition: flat-sequential and shared-sequential mean candidate chunk size = 1
attribution.batched_chunk_size: min(max_safe_flat, max_safe_shared, K), established by the feasibility probe per cell

chunking.flat_chunk_semantics: flat chunks recompute the complete prefix+candidate paths for each chunk

feasibility_discipline.model_residency: only one FP32 model pair resident per probe
feasibility_discipline.before_each_probe: clear allocator cache and reset peak memory statistics
feasibility_discipline.chunk1_unsafe_rule: if chunk = 1 is unsafe for either primary path, mark the cell hardware_infeasible; never substitute another prefix; applies equally at prefix 8192

chunking.primary_comparison_chunk_policy: each path may use its own largest safe chunk
chunking.shared_chunking_semantics: prefix computed exactly once per request and reused across all continuation chunks; candidate logits restored to original candidate order; softmax applied once over the full K-candidate set

execution_order.path_order: alternate by measured repeat: flat -> shared, then shared -> flat, repeating

correctness_gate.scope: every feasible measured cell; performance from a path is admissible only if it preserves FP32 equivalence on that cell

semantic_confirmation.selection: exactly the 24 records with metadata.suite == 'semantic' (they follow the 18 synthetic rows)

metrics.interpretation_clause: Logical token-position reduction is theoretical accounting, not measured FLOPs.

a2_interpretation.historical_phase1_gate: correctness AND (>= 2x effective throughput OR >= 50% independently measured computational-work reduction) with acceptable VRAM
a2_interpretation.work_reduction_restriction: The >=50% path may be invoked only if profiler/kernel evidence supplies an independent measured work proxy. Logical-position reduction alone does not qualify.
a2_interpretation.anchor_geomean: geometric-mean candidates/s speedup across the final unique anchor set

verdict_bands.conditional: 1.5x <= speedup < 2.0x, only if measured work reduction is clear
verdict_bands.below: < 1.5x: runtime bottleneck rather than architectural-speedup evidence

a2_interpretation.anchor_minimum: fewer than four unique feasible anchors disables both the strong and conditional A2 performance verdicts, regardless of the geometric mean
